key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3A62
name: return_without_action
description: A routine that takes no arguments and does nothing but return. It touches no registers, memory or library calls, and it is reached from one caller.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3A70
name: load_color_palette
description: Loads display colour palette entries by calling the graphics library's LoadRGB4 through the stored library base, after first passing an offset-adjusted value to a called routine. The pseudo-code makes the same library call twice in a row.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3AAC
name: calculate_scaled_product
description: Takes a 32-bit value, multiplies its upper 16-bit half by its lower 16-bit half, keeps the low 16 bits of that product, and multiplies the result by five.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3AC0
name: append_to_ring_buffer
description: Stores a 32-bit value at the write position of a sixteen-entry circular buffer in the base-relative data block. The write index advances modulo sixteen but stays put when advancing would make it equal the read index, so the buffer cannot overflow.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3AF0
name: poll_mouse_joystick_state
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port counters, derives direction-change bits by comparing them with the previous sample, and stores the new sample for the next call. It also runs countdowns that reload at three and at thirty-three, and a position counter that rolls over to zero after sixty and carries into the next digit.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3BCA
name: update_input_status_flags
description: Sets change-tracking bits in a status byte: a fixed bit, direction bits from comparing the high bytes of two input samples, a bit when a stored sixteen-bit value differs from the new one, and a bit when a global flag is clear. It then stores the new value for the next comparison.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3BE4
name: mark_button_input_changed
description: Sets a button bit in a status byte unconditionally, marks a change when a sixteen-bit value from the supplied block differs from the last stored one, and stores the new value. It also sets a flag when a global bit is clear.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3C18
name: dispatch_changed_input_bits
description: Encodes the current input word into a status byte, compares it with the previous status to find which bits changed, and for each changed bit calls a handler on a table of values over eight steps. It returns the updated value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3C90
name: layout_wrapped_text_stream
description: Walks a byte stream of text and control codes, accumulating characters into a line buffer. At line-end and some control codes it flushes the line, takes cursor positions from the following byte, and pads with spaces; at spaces it breaks the line when the text would exceed the window width, measured with the current font width.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:420E
name: call_subroutine_on_buffer
description: Reserves a thirty-byte local buffer and passes it to a called routine twice. The entry was found only as an unreached gap that decodes as code, so this may be a fragment rather than a deliberate function.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4248
name: set_active_record_index
description: Stores the low sixteen bits of its argument as the active record index in the base-relative data block. Other routines multiply that index by sixteen to find the fields of the current record.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4256
name: wait_blit_and_reset
description: Passes the active record's second field to a called routine, clears that record's next two fields and a shared word, and then calls the graphics library's WaitBlit through the library base to wait for the blitter to finish.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:42DC
name: store_record_fields
description: Writes four sixteen-bit values into a sixteen-byte record chosen by the low word of the first argument. The first value comes from the high word of that argument, the next two from the low and high halves of the second, and the last from the low word of the third.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4324
name: print_string_at_cursor
description: Prints a string into the current text window at the cursor. It calls a scroll callback when the cursor passes the bottom of the window, then draws the string on the current row and advances the column by its length, or moves to a new row first when it would not fit. It finally clears the first character of the source string.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4710
name: write_entry_via_dos
description: Looks up a four-byte table entry by the low word of its argument. If the entry is zero it runs one called routine, and if the entry's high bit is set it runs another, then calls the DOS library's Write routine through the library base.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:477C
name: call_indirect_function
description: Loads a function pointer from a fixed negative offset relative to a value passed on the stack and calls it. It does no other work, so it is a thin trampoline into a library routine at that offset.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:47B0
name: return_immediately
description: A routine consisting of a single return with no work. It takes no arguments and touches no registers, memory or library calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:47B2
name: return_at_once
description: A routine consisting of a single return with no work. It takes no arguments and touches no registers, memory or library calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:47B4
name: lookup_and_dispatch_entry
description: Calls a lookup routine and returns minus one if it yields nothing. Otherwise it calls a subroutine when a flag bit is set in the result, passes the stored value at offset two to a second subroutine, and returns minus one if a base-relative status word is nonzero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4818
name: delete_file_capture_error
description: Deletes a file through the DOS library and returns zero on success. On failure it reads the DOS error code, stores it in a base-relative status word, sets a state field to two, and returns minus one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4850
name: parse_args_and_open_console
description: Splits a command-line string into words, treating double-quoted spans as single words with escape sequences for an escape character and a newline, and stores pointers to up to thirty-two words. With no words it opens a console window from a fixed specification and finds the current task; otherwise it takes the standard input and output handles and opens the console. It then sets the per-handle flag words.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4A88
name: walk_entries_reverse
description: Walks a table of six-byte entries from the last to the first. For each entry with a nonzero first byte whose flag sixteen is clear, it calls a routine with the entry's stored value, then calls another routine with the argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4AAC
name: walk_entries_reverse
description: Walks a table of six-byte entries from the last to the first. For each entry with a nonzero first byte whose flag sixteen is clear, it calls a routine with the entry's stored value, then calls another routine with the low word of its argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4B08
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each character of a null-terminated string to uppercase in place, using a per-character attribute table in the base-relative data block. Only characters whose table entry has bit two set are changed, by subtracting thirty-two, and the original pointer is returned.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4B4C
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the maximum number of characters given in the third argument and terminating the result. The destination's existing contents are kept.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4BA8
name: compare_strings_ignore_case
description: Compares two null-terminated strings character by character, converting lowercase letters to uppercase first. It returns the difference between the first mismatching characters, or zero when the strings match through the terminator.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4BE4
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero byte of the first string and copies the second string, including its terminator, onto that position. It returns the original pointer of the first string.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4BFC
name: find_byte_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string from the start and returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given byte, or zero when the byte is absent. The terminator position is also tested, so searching for zero returns the end of the string.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4C22
name: forward_argument_to_routine
description: Passes its single argument straight through to another routine and returns nothing. It does no work of its own, so it is a thin forwarding wrapper.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4C3C
name: find_last_byte_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string and returns a pointer to the last occurrence of the given byte, or zero if the byte does not appear. The entry was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code, but its loop is complete and self-contained.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4C5C
name: return_without_work
description: Returns immediately with no work, taking no arguments and touching nothing. It was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code, so it may be an unused stub.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4C64
name: format_signed_decimal
description: Writes a signed integer as decimal ASCII digits into a buffer, preceded by a minus sign when the value is negative. It produces the digits by repeatedly calling a division routine, reverses them into place, terminates the string and returns its length.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4C70
name: format_decimal_sign_flags
description: Writes a decimal number like the routine that takes its sign from the argument, but decides whether to write a minus sign from the processor's negative and overflow condition flags. The digits are produced and reversed the same way, and the string length is returned.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4CA4
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a linked list from a base-relative head pointer, advancing through each node's first word and calling the exec library's FreeMem for the nodes it visits. It then clears the list head and a second list field and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4CD4
name: lookup_and_pass_entry
description: Calls a lookup routine and returns minus one when it yields nothing. Otherwise it passes the stored value at offset two to a second routine and returns minus one if a base-relative status word is nonzero after that call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4D24
name: update_changed_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of records starting at a base-relative head. For each record with bit two set, bit four clear and two stored words that differ, it calls a routine, and it calls one more routine after the loop.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4D74
name: write_and_record_error
description: Calls an optional callback stored in a base-relative pointer if one is set, clears a base-relative status word, and calls the DOS library's Write routine. When Write returns minus one it reads the DOS error code into the status word, sets a state field to five, and returns the result of Write.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4DC4
name: seek_file_position
description: Seeks in a DOS file through the library's Seek routine, after running an optional callback and clearing a status word. On failure it records the DOS error code in the status word and sets a state field to twenty-two. It then adjusts the offset argument according to a mode value, which may add the current position or perform a second seek, and returns the resulting offset.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4E3C
name: reset_fields_and_free
description: Sets a flag byte at offset eight to all ones and two longwords at offsets twenty and twenty-four to all ones, then calls the exec library's FreeMem through the library base.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4E68
name: release_resources_and_reset
description: Calls a release routine for a pointer stored at offset ten when that pointer is set, marks a flag byte at offset eight and a longword at offset twenty with all ones, calls a second release routine through the global table, and frees the block with the exec library's FreeMem.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4EA8
name: close_file_after_callback
description: Runs an optional callback stored in a base-relative pointer if one is set, then closes the open file through the DOS library's Close routine and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4ECC
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values taken from the data registers. It forms the cross products of the high and low 16-bit halves, adds them into the upper half of the result, and adds the product of the two low halves.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4EEC
name: divide_signed_32bit
description: Divides one signed 32-bit value by another and returns the quotient. Cases where a sign must be applied are delegated to another routine with the results negated where the signs require it. Otherwise it normalizes the divisor by shifting, estimates the quotient with sixteen-bit division, and corrects the partial result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4F04
name: negate_routine_result_pair
description: Calls a routine that returns a 64-bit value and returns both of its longwords negated.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4F0E
name: divide_to_word_quotient
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using normalization by shifts and sixteen-bit division, and returns the sixteen-bit quotient. A negative divisor is handled by calling another routine and negating its result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4F1E
name: divide_packed_quotient
description: Performs a normalized 32-bit division by a 32-bit divisor and returns a packed 64-bit result holding the sixteen-bit quotient in its upper bits and a remainder-derived value in its lower bits. The entry was reached as a gap that decodes as code, but its arithmetic is self-contained.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4F48
name: divide_with_normalization
description: Normalizes the divisor by shifting it left until its top bit is set, computes a sixteen-bit quotient and correction from the dividend and the scaled divisor, and returns the quotient with a rotated remainder packed into a 64-bit result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4FB0
name: print_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies the length-prefixed string at a base-relative pointer into a local buffer of at most seventy-nine characters and terminates it. If the current task has an output handle, it writes the text and a newline through the DOS library's Write and returns minus one; otherwise it calls a library routine and passes the buffer on, returning zero only when that routine reports one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:4FD2
name: copy_bytes_and_print
description: Copies a block of bytes of the given length into a local buffer and terminates it. It writes the buffer and a newline to the console output handle through the DOS library's Write when the current task has one, returning minus one, and otherwise passes the buffer to another routine, returning zero only when that routine reports one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:503A
name: open_intuition_library
description: Opens intuition.library by name through the exec library's OpenLibrary. On success it stores the library pointer in a local slot and passes it to a setup routine with fixed numeric parameters, returning zero when that routine reports one and minus one otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:5052
name: call_setup_with_buffer
description: Stores a pointer to a local buffer in a base-relative field, then calls a setup routine with fixed numeric parameters and the library pointer saved earlier. It returns zero when that routine reports one and minus one otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:508A
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other operations or memory accesses.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:50E8
name: allocate_and_set_node
description: Allocates a memory block when given a nonzero argument and returns zero for a zero argument or when allocation fails. On success it sets a byte at offset eight to five, a byte at offset nine to zero, and a longword at offset fourteen to the argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:5124
name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a memory node for a message port. If the node cannot be allocated the signal is released and zero is returned. On success it records the parameter and the current task, stores the signal number, then either initializes an empty message list or adds the port through the exec library, and returns the node.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:51B4
name: lookup_active_entry
description: Clears a base-relative status word and returns the address of the six-byte table entry for the given index, provided the index lies within the table and the entry is active. Otherwise it records error code nine and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:51F4
name: check_break_signals
description: Reads the task's signal state through the exec library's SetSignal call. When the break signal bits are set and a callback stored in the base-relative area returns nonzero, it clears that callback and calls another routine.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:0000
name: load_amiga_executable_hunks
description: Program entry that loads an AmigaDOS executable. It walks the hunk list, allocates memory for each code, data and bss hunk, copies contents into the code and data hunks while leaving bss hunks zero-filled, and applies relocation hunks by adding the load base to the longwords they name, stopping at the end marker. It then frees the working block.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:0138
name: spin_delay_counter
description: Busy-waits by decrementing a sixteen-bit count in a register until it wraps past zero, performing no other work. It returns once that loop completes.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:017A
name: return_unchanged
description: A routine consisting of a single return. It takes no arguments and is referenced through an address taken in code, and it does nothing when called.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:017C
name: decompress_backward_stream
description: Decompresses a bit-packed stream into a buffer, filling it from the end toward the start. It reads a length from the input, then repeatedly reads bit codes that either emit a literal byte or copy a run from output already written at a fixed distance, stopping when the write pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:01C8
name: shift_bits_from_stream
description: Extracts a count of bits from a bit-packed input into a result, refilling the bit buffer from earlier memory words when it runs out and carrying the last bit out in the extend flag. The loop count is the low word of a data register.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:EOB2:0:021C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decompiler output shows only a trap and a cache-invalidation call followed by a bad-instruction marker, so this is stub or bad data rather than a working routine.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0000
name: start_council_program
description: Program entry for the council executable. It clears a block of longwords, opens the DOS library by name, and returns an error code if that fails. Otherwise it builds a quoted argument string from the command line in allocated memory, runs two setup routines, and then closes and frees what it opened.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0176
name: execute_conditional_cleanup
description: Runs an optional callback stored in a base-relative pointer, then cleans up: if a second field is clear it frees a memory block when one is recorded, otherwise it replies to a message and closes a library. It returns a value read from a stored pointer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:01E4
name: initialize_council_scene
description: Clears a flag byte, runs a series of setup routines with fixed numeric arguments, then passes each of ten stored longwords to another routine. The referenced files are two council picture files and a music file.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0318
name: allocate_ten_table_entries
description: Runs a setup routine, then loops ten times: each pass obtains a value from a routine called with a fixed size, stores it in a table in the base-relative data block, and passes it with a position derived from the loop index to another routine.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:03A2
name: run_setup_call_sequence
description: Copies a five-byte value from a global block into a local buffer, sets a base-relative field, and then issues routine calls with fixed numeric arguments in several loops. One extra call is made at every sixteenth step using a value taken from the local buffer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:04EA
name: run_three_loop_passes
description: Sets a base-relative field, makes an initial call with fixed arguments, then runs three loops of calls with fixed numeric arguments, five passes, six passes and five passes, before a final call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0668
name: run_table_driven_sequence
description: Sets a mode field several times and calls routines with fixed numeric arguments. It then walks a zero-terminated list of indices from a base-relative buffer, skipping two special index values and issuing calls with fixed numeric arguments for each other index, and finishes with a loop over five stored values.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0902
name: run_table_setup_passes
description: Issues calls with fixed numeric arguments, then for each of four six-byte entries in a base-relative table calls another routine with that entry's fields. It then makes fifteen repeated pairs of calls with fixed arguments and finishes with a few more calls, including clearing a mode field.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0A90
name: build_three_buffer_sequence
description: Allocates three buffers with fixed sizes and then issues long runs of calls with fixed numeric arguments that use them. It loops over stored table entries in pairs and in sets of three, makes repeated back-and-forth calls with constant arguments, and finishes with a graphics library stub that waits for the vertical blank.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0E28
name: update_state_table
description: Handles one control value: when it equals ninety-nine it toggles a flag byte and calls an output routine with fields from a table. Otherwise, for each requested step it selects a slot from a value supplied by another routine, resets that slot's counter when it equals the step's marker and otherwise increments it, then calls an output routine with the slot's fields.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:0FF2
name: process_state_table
description: Copies six bytes of a global block into a local array. For a control value of ninety-eight it shuffles that array by swapping entries at positions chosen by another routine, then for each entry that differs from the given value it updates a record and calls output routines. For other control values it repeatedly selects a slot, toggles its state byte and calls an output routine with its fields.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:122C
name: execute_graphics_sequence
description: Copies three global bytes into a local buffer and sets a mode field. It issues one call with a fixed value, then either a single call selected by the index argument or, when a second argument is set, walks a record of bytes up to a sentinel value, alternating between two buffer entries and calling a routine for each entry; a final call uses the third buffer entry when that argument is set.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:13B4
name: update_rectangle_bounds
description: Steps a rectangle's position and size toward a target over repeated passes, limiting one dimension to twenty-one and adjusting the stored coordinates by values from another routine. It checks whether the moving rectangle has reached the target and stops when it has, issuing calls on each pass.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:162A
name: return_sign_of_value
description: Returns minus one for a negative argument, zero when the low sixteen bits read as a signed value are not positive, and one otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1646
name: store_high_bits
description: Stores the upper sixteen bits of its argument in a base-relative counter. When a flag byte is clear it then repeatedly calls another routine while the counter stays nonzero, so the caller waits until that routine clears it.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:166A
name: run_finale_sequence
description: Sets a mode field, issues several calls with a shared global block and values taken from pointer tables, and calls a routine with a fixed size argument. It reads and writes the intuition preferences through the library, and the text references are three finale picture files.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:171E
name: open_screen_window_and_devices
description: Opens the screen, window and display devices the program uses, setting up bitmaps, view and colour structures and loading the palette before bringing the screen to the front. Its text references are the console, graphics, input and intuition libraries and devices.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1BAC
name: check_available_memory
description: Asks the exec library how much memory is available and returns true when the amount exceeds five thousand.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1C3C
name: allocate_typed_node
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library, sets a type byte at offset eight to four, initializes the structure at offset twenty through a called routine, and returns the block.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1C6C
name: free_memory_if_nonzero
description: Frees the block through the exec library when the pointer argument is nonzero, returning the result of that call, and returns zero when the pointer is null.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1C8A
name: free_two_memory_blocks
description: Calls the exec library's FreeMem twice in succession through the stored library base, releasing two memory blocks whose addresses are held in registers.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1CB4
name: free_pointer_list
description: Frees a structure's four pointers at offsets four to sixteen, passing each nonzero one to another routine, then frees the structure itself with the exec library's FreeMem and returns its result. A null argument returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1CF2
name: free_block_with_optional_part
description: Frees the structure passed in, first freeing an optional part when its pointer field at offset twenty-four is set, and returns the result of the final free. A null argument returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1D26
name: free_memory_from_pointer
description: Frees the block whose address is passed in when that address is nonzero, returning the library call's result, and returns zero otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1D48
name: free_memory_if_valid
description: Frees the block whose address is passed in when that address is nonzero, returning the library call's result, and returns zero otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1D66
name: free_nested_structure
description: Looks at a type byte of a structure, masked to drop one bit. For several listed type values it passes the structure's child pointer to another routine, then if a counter field is nonzero it decrements it and frees a block, and finally frees the structure itself through the exec library's FreeMem.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1DFC
name: free_nested_structure_checked
description: Looks up a structure from its argument and, when one is found, applies the same type-based child release, counter check and final free as the routine that frees nested structures, returning the free result or zero when nothing was found. Its entry was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1E3C
name: release_node_and_counter
description: Releases a node by first passing its child pointer at offset six to another routine, then decrementing a counter at offset ten when it is nonzero and freeing a block, and finally freeing the node itself through the exec library's FreeMem. The entry was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code.

The entry was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1EA8
name: step_audio_volume_down
description: Disables interrupts, then counts the argument down one step at a time. Each step busy-waits through four delay loops of five thousand iterations and writes the current value to the four audio channel volume registers, then re-enables interrupts through the exec library.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:1F1E
name: setup_audio_device_channels
description: Copies a name string into a base-relative buffer, allocates a control block and opens the audio device with that name. It adds an interrupt server, initializes sixteen channel records by copying a template into each, and sets up the message and reply fields before it finishes.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:20E8
name: drain_two_linked_lists
description: Walks two linked lists held in a control block. For each node it saves the next pointer, passes the node to another routine, and stores the saved pointer as the new head, until each list is empty.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2132
name: shut_down_audio_device
description: When the active flag is set, removes an interrupt server, closes the audio device when one is open, releases two stored pointers through another routine, frees the control block, and clears the active flag and block pointer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:21B0
name: process_list_elements
description: When the flag is clear, walks a counted array of records. For each record it copies one field into another, selects the first nonzero entry of a pointer table and links it into the record while incrementing that entry's counter, then sets a bit mask byte to a single bit chosen from the count.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2222
name: parse_resource_tag_stream
description: Parses a stream of tagged records. One tag allocates a record and copies its payload into a new buffer, another copies a small fixed-size value and derives a count from it, a third copies a payload into a shared buffer and passes it to another routine, and a fourth copies a name and allocates a further block. A parse error frees the result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:248C
name: parse_resource_buffer
description: Allocates a block when the input has a body, then copies tagged payloads into it. A size tag stores the length and a newly allocated buffer for the data, and a text tag passes its copied string to another routine, stopping early on any error and freeing the block.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:25F0
name: allocate_and_copy_data
description: Allocates a block, stores a length word at its start, copies the given number of bytes from the source into it rounded up to whole words, and advances the source pointer past them. When allocation fails it sets an error flag instead.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:265C
name: parse_data_stream
description: Walks tagged records in a buffer, allocating a node for each chunk-type or multi-part tag and linking it into the parent's list, while copying a text tag into a local buffer and resolving another tag's value through a routine. Nested chunks are handled by calling a parsing routine on the data that follows.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2876
name: unlink_matching_list_nodes
description: Walks two linked lists while interrupts are disabled and unlinks each node whose name test returns zero, switching from the first list to the second when the first ends. It returns the last node it unlinked.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:294E
name: insert_list_element
description: Inserts a node at the head of one of two linked lists, chosen by its second argument, with interrupts disabled. Nodes placed on the first list are marked, and a flagged node is first removed through another routine; on that list it also records a count and updates the owner pointers of the entries it holds.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:29FA
name: process_nonempty_string
description: Returns zero for an empty string. For a nonempty string it passes the text to another routine and, when that returns a nonzero value, passes the result on to a second routine, then returns the first result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2A38
name: parse_resource_stream
description: Parses an IFF-style stream of FORM containers. For each FORM chunk it allocates a record, then reads its sub-chunk tags ST, US or VX to set a type byte to two, one or four and store a copied buffer, and an unknown tag sets an error flag. Each record also keeps a copied string and a count, and parsing stops on a bad header.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2CA0
name: clear_node_flag_and_process
description: Calls a routine with its argument, then calls another routine to get a node, and if the node exists clears bit sixteen in its flag byte at offset fourteen and passes the node to a further routine, returning that result or zero. The entry was reached only as an unreached gap that decodes as code.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2CD2
name: clear_list_attributes
description: With interrupts disabled, clears a flag bit on every node of the first linked list, zeroes a field in each of four table entries that are set, and clears another table word before re-enabling interrupts.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2D44
name: trigger_system_event
description: Calls the exec library's Cause routine to signal a software interrupt, then returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2D56
name: add_next_value_to_current
description: Adds the longword that follows the current address into the longword at the current address, then calls three routines and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2D76
name: assign_pending_node_to_slot
description: Walks a list of pending nodes, unlinking each unflagged node until it reaches a flagged one. It then picks the slot with the lowest priority value among four, obtains a request block through a library call, sets its fields and bit, and assigns the flagged node to that slot, repeating until the list is empty.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2DAA
name: assign_flagged_nodes_to_slots
description: Walks a pending list and, for each flagged node, assigns it to the slot with the lowest priority value, obtaining a request block through a library call and setting its fields. It stops when the list ends and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2DBA
name: assign_nodes_to_slots
description: Assigns the current pending node to the slot with the lowest priority value among four, obtaining a request block through a library call and setting its fields. It then walks the rest of the list, unlinking unflagged nodes until it reaches the next flagged one, and repeats until the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2E2C
name: return_no_effect
description: Returns immediately with no work, taking no arguments; it is referenced through an address taken in code.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2E32
name: move_nodes_between_lists
description: Walks the first linked list, calling a routine for each node according to its flag bits, then moves every node whose flag bit four is clear onto the second list while leaving flagged nodes in place. Returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2E50
name: requeue_unflagged_nodes
description: Walks a list from the head passed in, calls routines for flagged nodes, and moves nodes without flag bit four onto the second list, keeping flagged nodes on the first. Returns zero when the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2E60
name: requeue_nodes_by_flags
description: Walks a list, calling routines for nodes with flag bits four and two set, and moves nodes without flag bit four onto the second list while keeping the others in place. Returns zero when the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2E92
name: push_nodes_onto_list
description: Pushes a node onto the head of the second list, then walks forward calling routines according to flag bits and moving unflagged nodes onto the second list. Returns zero when the chain ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:2EAE
name: requeue_until_flagged_node
